plainText:
Whoosh!! To the Forest of Focus (Japanese: ギュンギュン！！いざ集中の森へ Whoosh!! Off to the Forest of Focus) is the 33rd chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 

==Major events==
Marnie wins a battle against Peony and she, Hop, and Bede join him in investigating the legends of the Crown Tundra.
and collect sap for a poison antidote and send it to Oleana.
